messages.subject: show rownames in renderDataTable?
parts: I looked around but didn't see this mentioned anywhere. Default is not to show them but can that be changed?

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: show rownames in renderDataTable?
parts:
I'm afraid there is no way except making row names a column of the
data to be displayed, e.g. cbind(names = rownames(mtcars), mtcars).
HTML tables only have the concept of table headers (<th></th>) which
can correspond to column names in R, and "row names" is only a concept
of R objects.

Regards,
Yihui
